rule: One block per session. Do not start the next block.

blocks.title: Local dev unblock
blocks.doneWhen: ./run.sh starts the dev server with no MariaDB, MinIO or Redis running
blocks.notes: Also carries PR #1's serial hardening (077b260, 6396b2e). Blocks 2 and 4 replace that work properly; leave it in place until they do.

blocks.title: Verification harness
blocks.doneWhen: yarn verify exits 0; CI runs it on push and PR
blocks.notes: vitest + fast-check, packages/am32-core skeleton with DOM/Node-free tsconfig, lint baseline to 0 errors, CLAUDE.md, this file, /block skill.

blocks.title: Delete removed features
blocks.notes: Bootloader flashing (.amj tab, AmjType), USB-direct mode (src/communication/direct.ts and its guards), bootloader downloads. Mechanical, no protocol work.

blocks.title: Protocol core extraction
blocks.notes: packages/am32-core: eeprom layout + byte-preserving codec (EEPROM_SIZE 192, CAN_SETTINGS as Uint8Array), MSP v1/v2 framing with error frames and echo check, 4-way framing, Mcu, hex. Fixes audit A (codec half) and D.

blocks.title: Link and transports
blocks.notes: Transport, Link, injectable Clock, drain semantics, retry, TimeoutPolicy. packages/am32-web replaces webserial-wrapper. Fixes E, G (hang + double drain), C.

blocks.title: Simulated FC and ESCs
blocks.notes: packages/am32-sim: SimEsc, SimFc (ArduPilot + Betaflight profiles), SimTransport, every fault knob, virtual clock.

blocks.title: Session API
blocks.notes: Am32Session + FC quirk modules. ArduPilot probe-then-wait, Betaflight fast path. Fixes B and H. Hardware checkpoint after this block.

blocks.title: UI as a thin client
blocks.notes: SerialDevice.vue shrinks to UI + store mirroring. Deletes src/communication/*, commands.queue.ts, dead store fields (I), the queue dependency. no-restricted-imports rule active.

blocks.title: Verified settings write and flash
blocks.notes: writeSettings with read-back verification, flash() with page handling, applyDefaults. Completes A and C. Drops the bootloader-version auto-write in getInfo. Hardware checkpoint after this block.

blocks.title: Headless CLI
blocks.notes: packages/am32-node + packages/am32-cli including --sim. Packaging per issue #3 section 6.

blocks.title: ARK32 firmware catalog
blocks.doneWhen: A deploy with no MinIO shows the ARK32 release list and flashing from the catalog works end to end
blocks.notes: Out of the sequential path. Do not attempt until ARK32#67 lands; there are no releases or tags to fetch.
